orientation: long axis parallel to saved C(k-1) to C(k+1) measured chord
candidate_order: station ID ascending, then left offset ascending; fixed before qualification
selection: smallest positive switch-to-conflict margin, larger first-CLEAR fraction, larger bypass clearance, lexicographic XYZ
render_policy: physical and some same-pair temporal gates must pass; chronological RGB+semantic captures from C1 through first CLEAR, or all 48 if none; no ray-based semantic labels
stop_policy: If none of these at most 12 candidates qualifies, stop. No additional placement or route search, no model run.
rationale: Four proximal inner-corner stations around the audited south wall endpoint, with centreline and two left/inward offsets; neither previous C19 nor C26 placement is repeated. Use the successful unchanged E16 route and lights; the previous E21 baseline failed its useful-RGB gate.
